task_instance: Produce a complete link building plan for a sample SaaS (a construction project-management tool) following the skill's 7-part Output Format: diagnose whether links are the bottleneck per target page from a supplied page-level link-gap export, inventory linkable assets, choose a tactic mix, build a qualified prospect list, draft outreach, note risk/policy issues, and set 30/90-day measurement targets.
evidence: Read the SKILL.md and its references (prospecting-and-outreach, tactics); Glob confirmed all referenced skill files (references/*, tools/integrations/*) are present, so no skill files are missing. Created realistic user-supplied INPUT under inputs/: a product-marketing context file, a page-level link-gap CSV (our referring domains vs the 3-5 pages that outrank us), and a prospect-candidates file standing in for backlink-tool/mention-monitor/AI-prompt output. Wrote the deliverable link-building-plan.md. Verified against the skill's Output Format: all seven required sections are present and internally consistent with the inputs -- (1) Diagnosis correctly reads an authority gap on the comparison page (8 vs 61/47/39 referring domains) and the smaller gap on the scheduling page, flags the homepage as needing no outreach, and adds the free internal-links move; (2) Assets identifies the unpublished data study as the first thing to build; (3) Tactic mix picks the four highest-yield low-content tactics from the skill table; (4) Prospect list is qualified on relevance/legitimacy/value/reachability with AI-cited flags; (5) Outreach drafts follow the skill's templates (under 100 words, lead with their page, one ask, anchors left to recipient); (6) Risk notes apply the 2026 spam-policy, anchor, pace, spread and paid-attribution rules; (7) Measurement reports by target page at 30/90 days. The core deliverable is a strategy/writing artifact that the runtime's text read/write abilities fully support; no code execution, binary output, web fetch, or connector was required (the skill's own model is to gather context from the user and produce a plan for approval). Files produced: inputs/product-marketing.md, inputs/page-level-link-gap.csv, inputs/prospect-candidates.md, link-building-plan.md, result.json.
